title: Bike Check Card
user: A self-maintaining cyclist who needs to capture a fault's exact symptoms, component state, photos, and ride context before deciding whether to pause riding or ask a mechanic/community for help.
smallest_useful_product: Offline form for bike, component, mileage, pressure, symptom timeline, sensor-vs-GPS reading, and annotated photos; exports a single private link/PDF. Non-goals: diagnosing safety, recommending replacement, telemetry ingestion, or social feeds.
success_measure: In a 20-cyclist test, at least 12 create and share a complete check card in under four minutes, with at least 80% containing bike, component, symptom, and one measurement.
constraints: Make the no-safety-advice boundary explicit; keep photos local until the user exports; avoid claiming compatibility with a component manufacturer's warranty process.
